title: stateBroadcast diagnostics cannot distinguish no-subscribers from a stalled worker
outcome: GET /api/diagnostics/persistence shows whether the state broadcaster has subscribers and is alive, so frozen stateBroadcast counters can be read correctly without opening an event stream.
acceptance: GET /api/diagnostics/persistence stateBroadcast exposes the stream_events receiver count, a broadcaster worker heartbeat or last-forward time, and the pending broadcast mailbox length.
A test covers the new fields: the receiver count follows subscribe and drop, the heartbeat or last-forward time advances when the worker forwards work, and the pending length reflects queued work.
Documentation of stateBroadcast notes that frozen counters with zero receivers are normal, because counters advance only on a send that reaches at least one receiver.
